games.name: Indo Voice
games.desc:
Welcome to Indo Voice!

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. As the pioneer of hangout games in Indonesia since 2014, we have dedicated more than a decade to perfecting the art of play and socialization.

💖 Features & Activities:
- Connect - Meet and chat with friends from all over Indonesia! 🇮🇩
- Voice Chat - Real-time chat for a more realistic experience! 🗣️
- Appreciate - Give & Receive Hearts to share a positive aura!
- Express - Share stories, jokes, or sing your favorite song! 🎶
- Fish & Play - Be on the edge while fishing or playing mini-games! 🎣🎮
- Customize - Look different with exclusive Aura, Trail, Pet, and Tools! ✨
- Vibe - Show off your style with a variety of dance emotes and movements! 🕺

games.name: Parkour Pandemic [UPDATE 2!]
games.desc:
(IMPORTANT: Development for Parkour Pandemic has paused due to personal reasons. Thank you all for your outstanding support!)

[THIS GAME IS IN BETA EXPECT BUGS]

The Fracture broke the world's clock. Time runs in a loop now, replaying the disasters that ended a hundred worlds. You're a survivor, You don't know how you got here...

This is a fast-paced running game where you survive disasters that tear the map apart around you. Rounds get harder as the clock runs down. Activate beacons to shorten the rounds time
Buy different gear with Volts to give yourself buffs. Like extra speed or even different mechanics.

🎛️ Controls
B - Emote
Q – Dash
C – Slide
Double Space – Double Jump

(Special mechanic controls:)

R – Air Blast (Power Gear)
Space near a wall – Wall Boost (Speed Gear)
Press the dash key again after a dash Q – Power Dash (Power Gear)

🎮 PC • Mobile • Console
🏆 Inspired by the Disaster & Parkour genres & Nullscape

games.name: Visual Pianos 🎹
games.desc:
Welcome to Visual Pianos, the best pianos on Roblox.

Play piano, perform with friends, and bring your favorite songs to life. We're a multiplayer music experience with customizable instruments, beautiful worlds, and spectacular visual trails.

🎹 Play solo, duet with friends, or perform for others. Show off your skills!
🎶 Choose from over 200+ different soundfonts; the largest collection on Roblox.
🎺 Type sf+ to mix and match up to 4 different instruments to play together!
🎨 Customize your piano, colors, trails, and visual effects. Express yourself!
🎛️ Play with QWERTY, MIDI, mobile, or tablet controls. Play VP wherever you are!
🤖 Type >auto to autoplay your favorite music sheets for free. 
🐾 Collect exclusive pets and discover more secrets throughout the game.
